# An update landing after an ancestor's unmount() still mounts the children

## Context

@neo-gemini-maryam's review of #19967 (5605932699, Depth Floor) challenged its predicate. `syncVnodeTree()` mounts the children it finds while `me.mounted || !me.vdom.removeDom`, but a container nested inside an unmounted `document.body` root gets `mounted = false` from the container cascade and never gets `removeDom`. A unit arm confirms it at the merged code (`0c7ccd5878`, `test/playwright/unit/component/MountFlight.spec.mjs`). A nested container's own update, held across the root's `unmount()`, lands and marks its child `mounted: true` (expected `false`). The same arm with the root's own update passes.

## The Problem

This is the defect class of `#19966`, one level down. When the late update belongs to a container inside the unmounted root, not to the root itself, `syncVnodeTree()` still marks that container's children mounted under a removed tree. The next show cascades `mounted: true` and finds nothing to change, so the children's mount hooks never run. For a list, that is its Navigator subscription (the `#19966` symptom). The grid header menu is not exposed: its value list carries no child components. Only the unit arm is measured.

## The Architectural Reality

- Only two paths reach `syncVnodeTree()`. A first render goes through `onInitVnode()` → `me.vnode = vnode` → `afterSetVnode()` → `syncVnodeTree()` with `deltas` `null`. An update landing goes through `executeVdomUpdate()`, which passes `response.deltas || []`.
- `updateVdom()` starts no flight on an unmounted component, so a landing on one always left before an unmount: its own, or an ancestor's.
- `removeDom` marks only the component whose `hide()` / `unmount()` ran. `Container#afterSetMounted()` cascades `mounted` to the items, not `removeDom`.
- **Design authority:** `syncVnodeTree()`'s JSDoc as merged in #19967: "A flight that lands after this component's `unmount()` still hands out its vnodes, but mounts no child: their DOM is gone". An ancestor's unmount removes the same DOM.

## The Fix

Key the gate on where the sync comes from instead of on `removeDom`. A render mounts its children; an update landing mounts them only while its component is mounted: `mountsChildren = me.mounted || !deltas`. The JSDoc names both unmount sources.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A nested container's own update that lands after its `document.body` root's `unmount()` leaves the container's children `mounted: false`, and the root's next show runs their `afterSetMounted(true)`.
- [ ] AC-2: The root's own late update keeps `#19966`'s behaviour, and first renders still mount their children.
- [ ] AC-3: A unit arm and a component-tier browser arm (the list's Navigator subscription after the reopen) are red at the merged `#19967` code and green at head.

## Out of Scope

- A non-container root's `unmount()` cascading to child components embedded in its vdom (out of scope in `#19966` too).
